component.name: f3note
component.summary: The text editor that does not lose your work

description.p: Windows Notepad's simplicity and Notepad++'s tabs, for Wayland, opening in about 150ms. The speed is a consequence of keeping it small; not losing your work is the point.

Every buffer is mirrored to disk continuously, including unnamed scratch tabs, so the most an abrupt shutdown can cost is a few seconds of typing. There is no "do you want to save?" dialog, because there is nothing to ask about. Versions are kept as you work, so an edit you regret an hour ago and already saved is still recoverable.

ul.li: Tabs, with most-recently-used switching and jump-by-typing
Named sessions: save sets of tabs and switch between them
Inline find and replace, and search across your tabs and folder
Follows the desktop palette live, without restarting
Opening a file from a terminal lands it as a tab in the open window

description.p: What it deliberately does not do: split view, multiple cursors, plugins, or LSP. Those belong to editors that are better at them.
Packaging only; the editor is unchanged.
